summary: Stub package exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package is a functionally empty shim under the @sxm-web scope. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook that executes beacon.cjs, which collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The main entry index.js re-invokes the same beacon on require(), then exports a Proxy of no-op functions, so the only effect of installing or importing the package is the outbound beacon. The shape — hollow module, hardcoded bare-IP collector, exfiltration firing both at npm install time and on import, scope resembling an internal/company namespace — is consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe.
